entity_raw.definition_raw: Saurian SubdomainSource Book of the Damned pg. 181, Paizo Blog - Golarion Day Subdomains pg. 1, Inner Sea Gods pg. 226Associated Domain(s): ScalykindAssociated Deities: Sobek, Ydersius, ZevgavizebReplacement Power: The following granted power replaces the serpent companion ability of the Scalykind domain. Dinosaur Companion (Ex): At 4th level, you gain the service of a loyal animal companion. Your effective druid level for the purpose of this animal companion is equal to your class level – 2. You must choose a dinosaur as your companion. Replacement Domain Spells: 4th—summon nature’s ally IV (deinonychus or pteranodon only), 5th—beast shape III, 7th—summon nature’s ally VII (brachiosaurus or tyrannosaurus only).
